title: Swap site hero + headshot photos with new professionally processed static assets

requirements.summary: Add the two newly uploaded photos as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and stop using the currently displayed site photos.
acceptanceCriteria: New image assets exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI (not served from the backend).
The previously used on-site photos are no longer displayed in the UI sections being updated (Hero and profile/headshot areas).

file_operations.description: Add the original uploaded hero source image as a static frontend asset (as requested).
Add the original uploaded headshot source image as a static frontend asset (as requested).
Remove the previously used hero image asset to ensure it is no longer displayed/used.
Remove the previously used headshot image asset to ensure it is no longer displayed/used.

requirements.summary: Replace the Hero section image with a professionally processed landscape hero photo derived from the newly uploaded image.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/training-planner/HeroSection.tsx no longer references /assets/generated/hero-trainingplanner.dim_1600x900.png and instead references the new hero photo asset.
The Hero image displays crisply on mobile and desktop (no stretching; maintain aspect ratio; appropriate object-fit styling if needed).

file_operations.description: Add the professionally processed hero image asset (derived from e3d60550-0886-11f1-b0bb-e7f856b020c7.jpg) as a static frontend asset.

Update the Hero image src to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-photo-v2.dim_1600x900.png (via the /assets/generated/... path) and adjust existing Tailwind classes as needed to preserve aspect ratio and prevent stretching (e.g., ensure appropriate object-fit behavior).

requirements.summary: Replace the header avatar and Professional Bio headshot with a professionally processed square portrait while keeping the logo fallback on load error.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/training-planner/Header.tsx and frontend/src/components/training-planner/ProfessionalBioSection.tsx reference the new headshot asset path by default.
If the new headshot asset fails to load, the UI falls back to /assets/generated/logo-jmf.dim_512x512.png as it does today.
The headshot remains correctly cropped as a circle in the UI without distortion (object-fit cover).

file_operations.description: Add the professionally processed square headshot image asset (derived from 1770831915760.png) as a static frontend asset.

Update the default avatar image state to use /assets/generated/jessica-headshot-v2.dim_800x800.png while preserving the existing onError fallback behavior to /assets/generated/logo-jmf.dim_512x512.png and keeping circle crop (object-fit cover).

Update the default bio headshot image state to use /assets/generated/jessica-headshot-v2.dim_800x800.png while preserving the existing onError fallback behavior to /assets/generated/logo-jmf.dim_512x512.png and keeping circle crop (object-fit cover).
